theme: European tourism statistics tooling: Eurostat tour_occ / tour_ce clients, INE Spain Frontur Egatur EOAT tourist-apartment tables, ISTAT, INSEE, Destatis, ONS travel, Portugal INE
queries_run: gh search repos "pyeurostat OR eurostatapiclient OR eurostat-api" --sort stars
gh search repos "insee api python" --sort stars
gh search repos "ons travel trends" --sort stars
gh search repos "INE Portugal turismo" --sort stars

candidates.name: ondata/opensdmx
candidates.what_it_holds: Python CLI + library for any SDMX 2.1 REST API, with named support for Eurostat, ISTAT, OECD, ECB and World Bank. Since Eurostat's tour_occ_* / tour_ce_* series and ISTAT's turismo tables are both published over SDMX, this is a single client that could pull tour_occ (nights spent, arrivals by NUTS2, monthly) and ISTAT tourism tables (Movimento dei clienti) without writing bespoke scrapers. 52 stars, actively updated (2026-09-14), MIT.
candidates.why_useful: Fills gap of a machine-pullable route to Eurostat tour_occ/tour_ce and ISTAT turismo at finer (NUTS2/monthly) grain than the tour_ce_omr platform-nights series we already hold; also reaches OECD tourism tables in one client. Relevant to gaps #5/#7/#17 (broad international stats via one SDMX client).
candidates.time_coverage: as published by source SDMX endpoints

candidates.name: eurostat/pyrostat
candidates.what_it_holds: Official Eurostat-org Python package/API for browsing and downloading Eurostat data collections (bulk + API), maintained under the eurostat GitHub org. 31 stars, updated 2026-03-27, EUPL-1.1.
candidates.why_useful: Authoritative, maintained client for pulling any Eurostat dataset code including tour_occ_ninat/tour_occ_arm/tour_ce_omn at whatever grain is published (country/NUTS2, monthly) — a one-command route to a finer-grained European tourism series than the platform-nights series already held.
candidates.time_coverage: as published (Eurostat tour_occ back to ~1990s for some series, monthly)
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: We hold Eurostat tour_ce_omr platform nights only; this reaches the broader tour_occ/tour_ce family (occupancy, arrivals, NUTS2) not yet pulled

candidates.name: lmeulen/EasyEuroStat
candidates.what_it_holds: Package for downloading Eurostat datasets by code, 13 stars, updated 2026-04-03, MIT.
candidates.why_useful: Alternate simple Eurostat downloader for tour_occ/tour_ce dataset codes if pyrostat/opensdmx have friction.

candidates.name: petres/eurostat
candidates.what_it_holds: Eurostat and OECD download tool with Stata and Excel export support, 11 stars, updated 2026-03-27.
candidates.why_useful: Alternate Eurostat+OECD puller; Stata/Excel export could be handy for the model pipeline; OECD reach also touches tourism satellite-account tables.

candidates.name: rasmuse/eust
candidates.what_it_holds: Tools to download, ARCHIVE, and read Eurostat data (2 stars, MIT). The archiving angle matters: it snapshots dataset pulls rather than always hitting the live (revised) series.
candidates.why_useful: Archiving a Eurostat pull is exactly the point-in-time / vintage capability called out as HIGH-value (gap #4) — Eurostat series like tour_occ get revised, and this tool is built to keep dated snapshots rather than only current values.

candidates.name: xemarap/eustatspy
candidates.what_it_holds: Python wrapper for the Eurostat APIs, 2 stars, updated 2026-02-22, MIT.
candidates.why_useful: Another lightweight Eurostat client option for tour_occ/tour_ce pulls; low differentiation from pyrostat/opensdmx but recently updated.

candidates.name: deepwaterpaladin/eurostatpy
candidates.what_it_holds: Basic package for querying/downloading Eurostat data by dataset name or ID, 2 stars, updated 2026-08-11, Apache-2.0.
candidates.why_useful: Another small, recently-touched Eurostat downloader; redundant with pyrostat but worth noting as a fallback.

candidates.name: opus-42/eurostat-api-client
candidates.what_it_holds: Simple Python client to query the Eurostat API, 7 stars, updated 2026-03-20, Apache-2.0.
candidates.why_useful: Another candidate Eurostat client; low differentiation, included for completeness/fallback.

candidates.name: imkejoor/airPaDE
candidates.what_it_holds: Code package (3 stars, MIT, updated 2026-03-10) that downloads and extracts Eurostat data parameters used in causal air-passenger-demand estimation, plus implementations of several air-passenger-volume estimation approaches between city pairs.
candidates.why_useful: Directly touches gap #10 (airline capacity/traffic) using Eurostat inputs — a ready-made air-passenger demand estimation toolkit for European city pairs, useful as an EU travel-volume proxy alongside tour_occ.
candidates.time_coverage: as published Eurostat air transport series

candidates.name: flame175kk-collab/frontur-estacionalidad-turismo
candidates.what_it_holds: Spanish-language repo analysing seasonality of Spanish tourism by country of origin and region (CCAA) using official INE Frontur/Egatur data pulled with Python; identifies which origin markets could fill off-season hotel demand. Updated 2026-08-28.
candidates.why_useful: A working Python pipeline against INE Frontur/Egatur (Spain inbound/outbound tourist arrivals and spend) broken out by CCAA and origin country — finer-grained than the INE Frontur/EOH series we already hold, and could be adapted to pull EOAT tourist-apartment tables from the same INE portal.
candidates.geography: Spain, by CCAA and country of origin
candidates.time_coverage: recent (as of repo date, likely multi-year Frontur/Egatur history)
candidates.duplicate_of_holding: We hold INE Spain Frontur/EOH at national level; this is a CCAA/origin-country-level pipeline, finer-grained

candidates.name: pipeworx-io/mcp-destatis
candidates.what_it_holds: MCP server for Destatis GENESIS-Online, Germany's official statistics database (includes Beherbergung im Tourismus / accommodation-in-tourism tables). Updated 2026-09-13, MIT.
candidates.why_useful: A live, current tool to query Destatis GENESIS for German hotel/accommodation nights and occupancy tables (Germany is a top-5 ABNB EU market); complements Eurostat tour_occ with a national-source route that may have finer NUTS/city detail and faster releases.

candidates.name: maschinenlesbar-org/destatis-genesis-cli
candidates.what_it_holds: TypeScript API client and CLI for the DESTATIS GENESIS-Online REST API (official German federal statistics), updated 2026-09-11, AGPL-3.0.
candidates.why_useful: Non-Python but current, actively maintained CLI for the same German tourism-relevant statistics tables as above; a fallback/alternate implementation.

candidates.name: KonradUdoHannes/genesispy
candidates.what_it_holds: Minimal Python client for the Destatis Genesis RESTful API, updated 2020-12-31, unlicensed stars=0.
candidates.why_useful: Older but minimal/simple Python option for the same German statistics tables; fallback to the MCP/CLI options above.

candidates.name: nilsme/restgenesis
candidates.what_it_holds: Basic Python and R functions to use the Destatis Genesis API, updated 2021-03-09.
candidates.why_useful: Another basic client for German federal statistics (tourism/accommodation tables included); dated but functional-looking, R support is a plus for cross-checking.

candidates.name: dr4hcu5-jan/destatis-genesis-api
candidates.what_it_holds: Destatis GENESIS API client, updated 2022-02-25, BSD-3-Clause.
candidates.why_useful: Yet another Destatis GENESIS client; included for completeness, redundant with entries above.

candidates.name: hanlulong/openecon-data
candidates.what_it_holds: MCP server + web UI exposing 330K economic indicators pulled from FRED, World Bank, IMF, Eurostat and others in one interface. 71 stars, updated 2026-09-13, active.
candidates.why_useful: A single tool to pull Eurostat tourism series alongside IMF/World Bank macro series for cross-checking European consumer strength and travel demand context; broader than tourism-specific but reaches the same Eurostat tour_occ/tour_ce codes plus IMF/World Bank travel-services trade data.

candidates.name: eurostat/Nuts2json
candidates.what_it_holds: Eurostat NUTS regional boundary dataset as JSON/TopoJSON for web mapping, 89 stars, active (updated 2026-09-11), EUPL-1.2.
candidates.why_useful: Not tourism data itself, but the NUTS2/NUTS3 geometry needed to join Eurostat tour_occ regional tables (published at NUTS2) to a map or to other geospatial STR/regulation datasets; low direct value but a useful joining key.

notes: Coverage is dominated by generic Eurostat API/download clients (many near-duplicate, low-star, single-purpose wrappers around the same REST/SDMX endpoints) rather than committed tourism datasets — nobody on GitHub seems to mirror tour_occ/tour_ce tables as static files, they all fetch live. The most useful finds are opensdmx and pyrostat, which can reach Eurostat tour_occ_ninat/tour_occ_arm and ISTAT turismo (Movimento dei clienti) tables at NUTS2/monthly grain, finer than the tour_ce_omr platform-nights series already held, and via one client each also reach OECD/ISTAT tourism tables without a bespoke scraper. Country-specific finds: one real INE Frontur/Egatur seasonality pipeline (Spain, CCAA-level) and several Destatis GENESIS clients (Germany, general federal stats incl. accommodation/Beherbergung tables) but no tourism-specific German or ISTAT-specific repos with committed data. Dead-end keyword searches: 'eurostat tour_occ' (0 results), 'INE frontur' (0, only found via 'frontur egatur'), 'istat turismo' (0), 'ons travel trends' (0), 'INE Portugal turismo' (0) — no dedicated ONS travel-trends client, ISTAT-specific tourism repo, or Portugal INE tourism repo turned up under these exact terms; opensdmx and openecon-data are the best fallback routes into ISTAT/ONS-adjacent data since they hit the underlying SDMX/statistical-agency infrastructure generically. Worth a follow-up scout searching 'ons statistics api', 'legado ISTAT SDMX', and 'INE Portugal API' with different phrasing, and checking pypi for an 'eurostat' package's GitHub source separately from what surfaced here.
